durations: Madame's piano played for 13 minutes, from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock
whereabouts: Ruedi was at dinner, where the master had the watches shown when the temple bell struck nine.
Monsieur Félix, Monsieur Girard and the doctor were at dinner, where their watches were shown.
After dinner, Ruedi went up to the atelier to work beside the master.
The master was in the atelier after dinner and went back to his bench after the regulator agreed with the temple bell at ten.
When the regulator showed 10:20, the master was in the atelier, in his shirtsleeves, bent over the repeater, and he sent Ruedi downstairs.
After leaving the atelier, Ruedi went straight down to the kitchen.
Ruedi stayed in the kitchen with Rosa from the time she came down until after the temple struck eleven.
Ruedi and Rosa heard Madame's piano from the kitchen.
Madame was playing the piano from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock.
